entries.source:
A group of bandits are drinking at their base.

"It's handy when you've got friends. \c[65]Friends 
 take rear attacks\c[0] and sometimes even
 \c[65]side attacks\c[0]. It's the frontal attacks you
 gotta worry about. When in danger, use
 someone as a shield. That's how I survive." 
 The little girl in the corner of the base looks
 up at the large monster next to her.

"Muddy protect Coco."
 The girl laughs at the monsters words,
 and they move silently closer together.
entries.translation:
一群山贼正在据点里喝酒。

“有同伴就是方便。\c[65]身后来的攻击由同伴承受\c[0]，
有时连\c[65]侧面攻击\c[0]也一样。
真正要担心的是正面攻击。危急时就拿别人当盾牌，
我就是这样活下来的。”
据点角落的小女孩抬头望向身旁的巨大怪物。

“Muddy保护Coco。”
女孩被怪物的话逗笑了，
他们静静地依偎在一起。
entries.previous_translation:

真正要担心的是正面攻击。危急时就拿别人当盾牌，
我就是这样活下来的。”
据点角落的小女孩抬头望向身旁的巨大怪物。

“泥泥保护Coco。”
女孩被怪物的话逗笑了，
他们静静地依偎在一起。

japanese_check.text:
ある山賊たちが、根城で酒盛りをしている。

「仲間がいるとき、\c[65]後ろからの攻撃は仲間が喰らう\c[0]。
　\c[65]横からの攻撃は、仲間か自分かどっちか\c[0]だな。
　正面からの攻撃はやべえぞ、全部自分が喰らっちまう」

　危険なときはうまく立ち回って、誰かを盾にすればいい。
　俺はそうやって生き残ってきたと笑う山賊の声が聞こえ、
　根城の隅にいた少女は、隣の大きな魔物を見上げる。

「ツチクレ　ココまもる」
「……へへ、ありがと！」
　魔物の言葉に少女が笑う。二人は静かに寄り添っていた。
japanese_check.internal_hint:
[K]ゲーム開始時Tips / <WORLD>の世界、酒場にて、
冒険家ウィリアムズが話をしている。

　仲間がいるときでも、\c[1]正面から受けりゃ全部自分が喰らう\c[0]。
　\c[1]横から攻撃を受けると、ときどき仲間の方に
　ダメージが行っちまう\c[-]。で、\c[1]後ろからだと、
　確実に仲間にダメージが行く\c[0]のさ……。

　何が言いたいって？
　まあ、ヤバいときは仲間を盾にしろって話よ。
　自分じゃなきゃ世界を救えないってんなら、
　何をやってでも生き残るんだ。
　それが使命を負った者の『義務』だ……重いぞ」 / 表示文章

entries.source:
With a mighty blow, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]
 pierced the heart of \c[51]Alma\c[0],
 the Fallen Angel.

"It can't be... How could a mere mortal
 defeat a godly creature such as I?"

 \c[51]Alma\c[0] fell to her knees, her face
 filled with utter disbelief.
 
 As her consciousness slipped away,
 she whispered a name...

"Oh... \c[51]Pluton\c[0]..."
entries.translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]倾尽全力的一击，
 贯穿了堕天使\c[51]Alma\c[0]的心脏。

“不可能……我这样的神之造物，
 竟会败给区区凡人？”

 \c[51]Alma\c[0]满脸不可置信地跪倒在地，
 随后瘫倒在大地上。
 
 在逐渐模糊的意识中，
 她低声念出一个名字……

“啊……\c[51]Pluton\c[0]……”
entries.previous_translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]倾尽全力的一击，
 贯穿了堕天使\c[51]阿尔玛\c[0]的心脏。

“不可能……我这样的神之造物，
 竟会败给区区凡人？”

 \c[51]阿尔玛\c[0]满脸不可置信地跪倒在地，
 随后瘫倒在大地上。
 
 在逐渐模糊的意识中，
 她低声念出一个名字……

“啊……\c[51]Pluton\c[0]……”

japanese_check.text:
こん身の力で放った\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]の強烈な一撃が
堕天使\c[51]アルマ\c[0]の心臓を貫いた。

「バカな……、神に近い存在の私が
人間に負けるなんて……。」

\c[51]アルマ\c[0]は信じられないという表情で膝をつくと
崩れるように大地に倒れ込んだ。

「うう……冥王……様……。」

\c[51]アルマ\c[0]は薄れゆく意識の中でつぶやくと……、
そのままゆっくりと目を閉じたのだった。

entries.source:
Suddenly...

 The approaching \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0] vanished,
 leaving only white ash and rubble as far
 as the eye could see in the Western lands...
 
"\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], we finally did it!
 We won!"

 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] summoned the last
 bit of strength remaining in their battered
 body to turn back and face
 \c[51]Memoria\c[0] with a smile.
entries.translation:
突然……

 逼近的\c[52]光之灾厄\c[0]消失了，
 西边的大地只剩下一望无际的
 白灰与瓦砾……
 
“\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]，我们终于做到了！
 我们胜利了！”

 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]用遍体鳞伤的身体
 勉强聚集起最后一丝力气，
 转过身来，朝\c[51]Memoria\c[0]露出了微笑。
entries.previous_translation:

japanese_check.text:
そして気がつけば……。

背後に迫っていた光の災厄は完全に消え去り、
そのあとには白い灰とガレキに埋もれた
西の大地だけが広がっていた……。

「\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]、ついにやったね。
あたしたちの勝利だよ！」

\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]は傷ついた身体をやっとの思いで
持ち上げると、\c[51]メモリア\c[0]に振り返って微笑んだ。

"These are all parallel universes.
 I exercise influence bit by bit
 to create countless parallel worlds.
 Behold! For beauty such as these are
 surely the pinnacle of artistry!"

 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] did as was told and
 peered down into the different worlds.

 While in each the arrangement of the land
 and towns differed, there was always a
 King \c[51]Konrath\c[0], and a person like
 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
entries.translation:
“这些都是平行宇宙。
 我一点一点施加影响，
 创造出了无数个平行世界。
 看吧！如此美景，
 无疑是艺术的至高境界！”

 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]依言
 向一个个不同的世界望去。

 每个世界的地形与城镇布局虽然不同，
 但总有一位国王\c[51]Konrath\c[0]，
 也总有一个像\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]的人。
entries.previous_translation:

 但总有一位国王\c[51]康拉斯\c[0]，
 也总有一个像\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]的人。

japanese_check.text:
「これらはすべて同時に存在する並行世界じゃ。

ワシは自らの世界に少しずつ影響を与え、
無数の並行世界を生みだしているのじゃ。

見よ！　これこそまさに美の極み、
最高の芸術作品と言えよう。」

\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]は促されるままに
さまざまな並行世界をのぞき込んだ。

すると地形や町の配置に違いがあるにせよ……、
どの世界にも国王\c[51]コンラス\c[0]が治める王国があり、
そこには\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]の姿もあった。

Everything after that, you already know. He sent
 a light monster into my beautiful, artistic worlds.
 Every world was affected by the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0]
 and many were destroyed.

 That's why I entrusted peace in all worlds
 to you.

 You, \c[51]Konrath\c[0], and
 \c[51]Memoria\c[0] are all children I created
 to keep the worlds in control.
 You are golems I made."
entries.translation:
之后发生的事，你都已经知道了。他将一头
 光之怪物送入我那些美丽的艺术世界。
 每个世界都受到\c[52]光之灾厄\c[0]影响，
 其中许多已经毁灭。

 所以，我把所有世界的和平
 托付给了你。

 你、\c[51]Konrath\c[0]，以及
 \c[51]Memoria\c[0]，都是我为了维系世界
 而创造的子女。
 你们都是我制造的魔像。”

あやつはワシの芸術的世界に

あの\c[52]シャインレイド\c[0]によって
すべての並行世界が影響を受け滅びようとしていた。

だからワシは、
そなたに世界の平和を託したのじゃ。

何故ならば、そなたや\c[51]コンラス\c[0]、そして\c[51]メモリア\c[0]は
世界を管理するために生まれた神のおとし子……、

entries.source:
A golem created by a god?
 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] couldn't believe it.
 They felt the same as anyone else.

"\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], have you ever
 felt that you've lived a past life?
 Yes...that's right.
 That feeling was actually a memory.

 When you died while on your travels
 \c[51]Memoria\c[0] saved your memories,
 just like she did with all the
 incarnations of you who came before."
entries.translation:
由神创造的魔像？
 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]简直无法相信。
 他们觉得自己和其他人毫无分别。

“\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]，你是否曾
 感觉自己经历过前世？
 对……没错。
 那种感觉其实是一段记忆。

 当你在旅途中死去时，
 \c[51]Memoria\c[0]会保存你的记忆，
 就像她对此前所有转世的你
 所做的那样。”

「\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]よ、何度も自分がよみがえる……、
そんな感覚に陥ったことはないか？

……ああ、そうじゃ。
それは錯覚ではない。事実じゃ。

旅の途中でそなたが死んでしまったとき、
\c[51]メモリア\c[0]にはそれまでの\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]の記憶を
持ち帰らせていたのじゃ。

\c[51]Memoria\c[0] could only shake her
 head in surprise.

"Unfortunately, many times you collapsed in
 the middle of your mission and those worlds
 were destroyed by the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0]...

 I hypothesized that if we transferred your
 memories of failed adventures to
 other parallel worlds...

 ...That someday you would finally succeed
 across the gulf of time and space."
entries.translation:
\c[51]Memoria\c[0]只能惊讶地摇着头。

“很不幸，你曾有许多次在完成使命前
 倒下，那些世界也被\c[52]光之灾厄\c[0]毁灭了……

 我设想，如果把你在失败冒险中的记忆
 转移到其他平行世界的你身上……

 ……那么终有一天，你便能跨越时空的鸿沟，
 最终完成使命。”

残念ながらそなたが使命半ばで倒れた世界は
\c[52]シャインレイド\c[0]に滅ぼされてしまったが……。

他の並行世界にいる\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]へ
亡きそなたが経験した記憶を移植すれば、

With the death of \c[51]Alma\c[0] the Fallen Angel,
 the threat of\c[52]Shine Raid\c[0] disappeared, and
 with King \c[51]Konrath\c[0] gone, the work of governing
 the world now fell to \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].

 With the damage from the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0], rebuilding
 the country would take time.

 Even so, the kingdom soon reclaimed its power
 and began to change.

 There was great change in
 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]'s personal life as well.
entries.translation:

 \c[52]光之灾厄\c[0]的威胁随之消失，
 而国王\c[51]Konrath\c[0]也已经不在，
 治理世界的重任就此落在\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]肩上。

 \c[52]光之灾厄\c[0]造成的破坏十分严重，
 重建王国需要时间。

 即便如此，王国很快便恢复了力量，
 并开始发生变化。

 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]的个人生活
 也发生了巨大的变化。

 who had won a fierce battle.

 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] buried their late father,
 \c[51]Konrath\c[0], beside the fallen castle and
 immediately set upon rebuilding the kingdom.

 With King \c[51]Konrath\c[0] gone, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]
 became the ruler of this world.
 Under \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]'s masterful rule,
 the kingdom was rebuilt in no time at all.

 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] gazed at the eastern skies from the castle window.

 In time, they planned to travel in search of
 their reborn companions to celebrate peace
 together.

 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] looked down upon the rebuilt
 castle town and thought to themselves
 that they sincerely hoped these
 peaceful times would continue forever.
entries.translation:
\c[51]Memoria\c[0]在一旁说着笑话，
 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]则从城堡的窗口眺望东方天空。

 过些时日，他们打算踏上旅途，
 寻找重获新生的同伴，共同庆祝和平。

 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]俯瞰重建中的城下町，
 心中默默祈愿这段和平时光
 能够永远延续下去。

On this day, from King \c[51]Konrath\c[0]'s castle, a single
 messenger raven took flight towards the east.
 The castle town was reflected in its eyes.
 At the cathedral, two childhood friends from
 the north and south of the castle town were
 getting married to the joy of all who knew them.

 The bride tossed her bouquet high for the
 hopeful young girls to chase after.

 However, now one would ever guess
 that this young couple would become thieves,
 spending their lives stealing to give to the poor.
entries.translation:
这一天，一只传信渡鸦从国王\c[51]Konrath\c[0]的城堡
 向东飞去。城下町的景象映在它的眼中。
 教堂里，一对分别住在城下町南北两端的
 青梅竹马正在众人的祝福中举行婚礼。

 新娘高高抛出花束，
 憧憬婚姻的少女们纷纷追上前去。

 然而此刻谁也不会想到，这对年轻夫妇
 日后竟会成为义贼，一生劫富济贫。

その瞳には、城下町が映し出される。

すると教会では、
城下町の南北に住む幼なじみの男女が
皆の祝福を受け、結婚式を挙げていた。

花嫁の投げたブーケは天高く舞い、
花嫁を夢見る少女たちがそれを追いかける。

しかし、この若い夫婦がのちに義賊となり、
貧しい人たちに金品を配る人生を送ろうとは、
この時はまだ誰も気づいていない。

The knight was heading west. His sworn enemy,
 King \c[51]Konrath\c[0], held court in that direction. He had
 begun his journey intent only on killing King
 \c[51]Konrath\c[0]. But things had changed now.

"Before I kill him, I guess I'll at least hear what he
 has to say."

 The childlike innocence of the girl he traveled
 with now had begun to melt his heart.

 For several days thereafter,
 the messenger raven flew on.
entries.translation:
骑士一直向西前行。
 他的宿敌国王\c[51]Konrath\c[0]就在那个方向。
 他起初只为杀死国王\c[51]Konrath\c[0]而踏上旅途，
 但如今情况已经不同。

“杀他之前，至少先听听他要说什么吧。”

 与他同行的小女孩天真无邪，
 正在慢慢融化他的心。

 此后数日，
 传信渡鸦继续向前飞去。

かたきである\c[51]コンラス\c[0]王が治める城があるからだ。

初めは\c[51]コンラス\c[0]王を殺すために始めた旅だった。
しかし今は少し事情が違っていた。

「殺す前に話くらい聞いてやってもいいだろう。」

旅を共にしている幼い娘の無邪気さが、
騎士の心を溶かしはじめていたのである。


それから数日間……、
伝書ガラスは休むことなく飛び続けた。

 raven made one full trip around the world
 and returned to King \c[51]Konrath\c[0]'s castle. There, it
 was greeted by King \c[51]Konrath\c[0]'s child, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].

 BG:SystemGra/SC_UI/bg/ep_05.jpg

 Next to \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] stood a woman with a
 gentle smile.

 A year before, she had been wandering the world
 with no memory. Where upon she met \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]
 by chance, and \c[53]they\c[0] immediately became close.

 后来她与\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]偶然相遇，
 \c[53]两人\c[0]很快便亲近起来。

Her memories had not yet returned. But perhaps
 there was no need for them now. Because
 in place of the memories she lacked, they would
 create new ones \c[53]together\c[0].

 And then, when tomorrow came, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] had
 a fateful meeting with the knight who had saved
 the monster and young girl.

 From that day, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] would be blessed with
 great military strength to lead the
 world to prosperity as King \c[51]Konrath\c[0]'s heir.
entries.translation:
她的记忆仍未恢复。但如今或许
 已经不再需要那些记忆。因为缺失的记忆，
 将由\c[53]两人\c[0]今后共同创造。

 到了明天，\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]还将与那位
 救下魔物和小女孩的骑士迎来宿命般的相遇。

 自那一天起，\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]便得到强大的
 军事助力，注定会作为国王\c[51]Konrath\c[0]的继承人
 带领这个世界走向繁荣。

"And this is also where you all will die."

 With a fearsome grin, \c[51]Alma\c[0] descended from the
 heavens before \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] and the others,
 blocking their path.

 A world of death stretched before them.
 And from behind, the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0]
 grew ever closer.
entries.translation:

 \c[51]Alma\c[0]露出狰狞的笑容，

The giant looked down upon them,
 massive frame ablaze with the light that had
 driven the kingdom to ruin.

"Behold my servant, \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0]! The one who will finally destroy this world!"

"We're backed into a corner now...
 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], what should we do?"

 Instead of answering \c[51]Memoria\c[0], \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]
 drew their weapon. There was only one option.
 They had to defeat the enemy before them!
entries.translation:
巨人俯视着他们，
 庞大的身躯燃烧着曾将王国推向毁灭的光芒。

“看吧，那就是我的仆从\c[51]Zeukrees\c[0]！
 它将最终毁灭这个世界！”

“我们已经无路可退了……
 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]，我们该怎么办？”

 没有回答\c[51]Memoria\c[0]，\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]
 拔出了武器。答案只有一个。
 他们必须击败眼前的敌人！

"This is what they mean when they say life is full
 of uncertainty."

 No one could deny that \c[51]Memoria\c[0] was correct,
 but they had to push forward. \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]
 and their companions had no other choice.
 So when they took one more step into
 the darkness...

 The floor seemed to drop away under their feet
 and they began to plummet into total darkness.

 It was like they had fallen into a crack in eternity.
entries.translation:
“所谓人生无常，指的就是这种事吧。”

 没有人能否认\c[51]Memoria\c[0]说得对，
 但他们必须继续前进。\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]
 和同伴们别无选择。
 于是，当他们又向黑暗中迈出一步……

 脚下的地板仿佛消失了一般，
 他们坠入了彻底的黑暗。

 就像坠入永恒的裂隙。
